name: status-board
title: Status board
description: Twice a day (08:30, 19:30): collects pull requests, issues, milestones, CI, test results and the routines' runs into one snapshot and writes it to the status board artifact's database. Read-only everywhere else.
notes: The installer builds and publishes the page first (docs/status-board.md) and saves its URL as status_board_artifact in harness.json; without it each run stops at once. Settings in status-board.json next to bin/ (timezone, CI workflows, optional test results).
